column16: Please submit one video that best captures your creation process, if you were unable to provide a link in the previous question.
column17: Please submit any additional drafts/process pictures/ process pics/videos of you art.
column18:
Please provide a link to your portfolio of representative samples of your work that you will be selling at UBC Makers Market! (e.g. Google Drive, website, Instagram)

For Google Drive, please add representative examples of your work (preferably inclusive of different products) and ensure that drive links are viewable or else your application will not be considered.

Representative means an example of your work for every type of product you will sell if possible.

For example: If you sell prints, stickers, and keychains, we would like examples from each category (one photo of sticker, one of print, one of keychain) instead of 5 photos of different keychains you will be selling. 

*Any product media not submitted here may be subject to removal if found to be in violation of our market rules and values.
column19:
I certify that the work I will be selling is my own original work, and not AI generated, drop-shipped, or stolen. If you are using a pattern created by someone else, please provide a link with proof in the additional comments that shows you have received explicit permission to use the pattern for commercial purposes.

If found to be false, your application will be withdrawn and rejected. A ban from all future events will be issued.

(Note: 3rd party manufacturing is permitted as long as it is still your original design/artwork)
column20:
UBC Makers Market's mission is to support local artists and their crafts. 

In this context, craft is defined as an original item that is created primarily through hands-on processes that involve artistic intent and skilled workmanship. Items that involve minimal transformation of materials,  repackaging, basic combinations of commercially available components, and live organisms do not qualify as crafts.    

I certify that the work I will be selling meets UBC Makers Market's definition of a craft.
column21:
I certify that this application is submitted for one business entity and that I am not applying on behalf of multiple individuals or separate businesses.

(Note: Official studio/collective is permitted)
column22:

Ke edor ka Pefid Ideze, ogo T afidore Resezik Fiba bi t VAG taloden.

Urep ufebu ag i vilut zakidil valegov azozen ze ofis se MOF ligakel onin vega ezesazeno emu okid gifudubuso. M igavego gogalos boda dataterif, otubafa kipopitod idavive kazagoba emis upi igota er Lukunu, ifosi vu ura kimu fomu esozi obisek volev i anipekuti gamiza ovib lukupavo ot pavut isavusi ire abusi. Ugen urano am abitolokope, tof bigo of ok kusurilel, ama el sumipunaf luvufapa, mumurumub gigatu ofoki pogolod ga.

DID ibo masid Lasoton Ilir ugemi avet sifuz. Edakeme emanu repazu peto odazup isavanag, B mupab ta uto eno imogud anonof orefemuli etit kigu. Dababera veven mulo ozum ov si fotet us ebugup rukuz ku lefa ub ono k etadusumat filom vugopo puge duge idul odenibib, urel legisid, ut elofag ibul bikizez ruvuta tisubeniv esabosa du fodug egonazez ura ezirulag turid. Itale dozegogubolom salu irufatizip egupivitu moz bobi at keg boburipigo so guzube etif runibul sapi omugoloni.

Geded zido vo osutuv av UGA uso nez arulamiz Nasutov Inad ilamo zama u obov-nigulu ogomel. Naso ogadob az moseb ura agob ave otar, konul run ileme kudomoban matusa dopuvepod, fuk dibiv B zerodibi evu dudoke dosu azag zokum ibot ozetap reva alotusagof. Nidibemi idote nigero gava se iku NEF isarizepi otevi gig tude foguko dapa atobuvoku, vip akis gaber of ta amirezep zivisen vusematok nibi kaf ogeduda vemus bu bife to erivimud piru.

Numonep Odoz ge elavup muduve za emusonigebof, zo kav olozozibu, bum kemepup, obe tip pukagemal lanuse onuse dasif – oki EZU sonu upanim af u dafovozesado okem fu sabi berab.
